title: Approved EmDash kits are discoverable without changing contract sealing
steps: Run authored Restaurant kit discovery and malformed identity controls against checkout and image-shaped fixtures.
expect: The existing approved Restaurant kit and exact content map open without inventing a profile manifest.
Malformed, empty and mismatched metadata cannot acquire an approval.
Explicit custom indexes remain isolated; default discovery is cached.
Duplicate claims fail closed and shipped image artifacts precede checkout artifacts.
